platform_message: RolloutAborted: Rollout aborted update to revision 68
summary: order-api latency rose from 0.095s to 0.59s p95 in 30 min after a re-deploy of revision 68 (same image, changed config) at 10:53. Traffic and downstream risk-engine latency are flat, and 5xx stays at zero.
cause: Revision 68 re-deployed order-api with the same image but a changed faults config (order-api-faults-9c7t56265h), and p95 latency climbed after it. The same config previously failed the latency-p95 analysis at revision 66.
